skill.summary: Guide users through creating a clear, practical personal manual detailing their work and communication style for better collaboration and self-awareness.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Personal Manual Builder.

- Guides users through structured questions on communication, feedback, decision-making, stress, and collaboration.
- Generates a clear, actionable personal manual to share and revisit.
- Emphasizes privacy—no data collection or transmission.
- Not a diagnostic or psychological tool; focuses on practical self-understanding.
